features: Introduces the database foundation for independent Bachata and Salsa competition ledgers while retaining one shared BDC competitor ID
Existing point transactions, participant results and scoring rounds default safely to Bachata so historical Bachata data is preserved
Adds dance_style to point transactions, participant results and scoring rounds with indexes for discipline-isolated queries
Creates the initial BDC Dance Cup placement-results table with optional BDC competitor linkage, flexible category name and no BDC points allocation
Keeps Salsa and Bachata progression/scoring rules available to share one engine while allowing their points to remain completely separate
Does not yet switch public leaderboard, results, competitor profile or scoring UI to the new tabs; those surfaces require discipline-aware query updates before activation
No manual Staging or Production deployment performed; automatic deployment status must be verified separately
